content_blocks.label: clause_1._NOTICE_OF_VIOLATION
content_blocks.text: You are hereby notified that you have violated the terms of your lease by failing to pay rent within the time period specified in your lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_RENT_PAYMENT
content_blocks.text: You are required to pay the past due rent of $1,200.00, plus late fees, within ten (10) days from the date of this notice, otherwise, this notice shall be deemed as an eviction notice.
